title: Step 2b - Building a Polynomial Regression Model: Adding Squared & Cubed Terms

cues.en: Instructor: And this little something that we're going to add is actually the polynomial features.
cues.zh: 要加上的這一點東西，其實就是多項式特徵。

cues.en: The polynomial features are actually some additional independent variables that are gonna be the level squared, the level cubed, level to the fourth, level to the fifth,
cues.zh: 多項式特徵是額外的自變數，分別為職位等級的平方、三次方、四次方、五次方，

cues.en: up to any degree you want.
cues.zh: 一直到任何你想要的次數。

cues.en: These are these additional independent variables that are going to compose our new matrix of features in some way, which will actually be the matrix
cues.zh: 這些額外的自變數，會組成新的特徵矩陣，

cues.en: on which we will apply a multiple linear regression model, which will make the whole model a polynomial regression model.
cues.zh: 接著對這個矩陣套用多元線性迴歸模型，整體就成了多項式迴歸模型。

cues.en: So in short, a polynomial regression model is a multiple linear regression model that is composed of one independent variable and additional independent variables
cues.zh: 簡單來說，多項式迴歸就是多元線性迴歸，其組成包含一個自變數，以及額外的自變數，

cues.en: that are the polynomial terms of this first independent variable.
cues.zh: 而這些額外自變數，就是第一個自變數的多項式項。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now that we get this idea, you'll perfectly understand what we're about to do right now when building our polynomial regression model, because what we're going to do
cues.zh: 理解這個概念後，你就能完全理解接下來建立多項式迴歸模型時，

cues.en: is to build these polynomial terms.
cues.zh: 為什麼要建立這些多項式項。

cues.en: And to that extent, what we're simply going to do is to add specifically a new column here in this dataset, which will be the level squared.
cues.zh: 為此，我們只要在資料集中明確新增一欄，內容是職位等級的平方。

cues.en: So we're gonna call this new independent variable Level2 and let's add this new column right now.
cues.zh: 將這個新自變數命名為 Level2，現在就新增這一欄。

cues.en: So to add a column in a data frame, we need to take our data frame, so it's dataset, here it is.
cues.zh: 要在資料框中新增欄位，先使用資料框，也就是 dataset，在這裡。

cues.en: And then we need to add a dollar sign here, and then we can add any name here which will create a new column of this name and add it into our dataset.
cues.zh: 接著加上錢字號 $，然後輸入任意名稱，就能建立同名的新欄位，並加入資料集。

cues.en: So we're gonna call this column Level2 because we're taking the level squared of our 10 levels, then we add equals, and then we actually need to give the formula
cues.zh: 將這欄命名為 Level2，因為要取 10 個等級的平方。接著加上等號，再寫出

cues.en: of the values in this level two column of our dataset, and this formula is therefore the levels in our dataset at the power of two.
cues.zh: 資料集 Level2 這一欄的數值公式，也就是原本職位等級的平方。

cues.en: So very simply, we're gonna take all the levels of our dataset by taking our dataset, and same, adding this dollar here to take the level column,
cues.zh: 很簡單，先使用 dataset，同樣加上 $，取得資料集中的所有職位等級，也就是 Level 欄位，

cues.en: which is here, I just have to press Enter.
cues.zh: 就在這裡，只要按 Enter 即可。

cues.en: So by doing this, I'm taking the level column that is all the values of the level column in our dataset.
cues.zh: 這樣就取出了 Level 欄，也就是資料集中 Level 欄位的所有數值。

cues.en: And now I'm going to take the square of all these levels in our dataset, and so to do this very simply, I just add hat and two.
cues.zh: 現在要取這些等級的平方，只要加上 ^2 就行。

cues.en: That's it.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: That will just create a new column which will contain the squares of our 10 levels in our dataset.
cues.zh: 這會建立一個新欄位，包含資料集中 10 個職位等級的平方。

cues.en: So let's see.
cues.zh: 來看看。

cues.en: Right now my dataset contains only two columns, Level and Salary.
cues.zh: 目前資料集只有 Level 和 Salary 兩欄。

cues.en: And if I execute this, here we go.
cues.zh: 執行這一行，就完成了。

cues.en: Now let's have a look at the dataset.
cues.zh: 現在看看資料集。

cues.en: As you can see, I now have three columns, Level, Salary, and Level2.
cues.zh: 可以看到，現在有 Level、Salary 和 Level2 三欄。

cues.en: And as you can notice, the values in the Level2 column are the squares of the values in the Level column.
cues.zh: 也可以注意到，Level2 欄裡的數值，就是 Level 欄數值的平方。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And now we can build our polynomial regression model because now this dot here not only contains the Level column but also the Level2 column,
cues.zh: 現在可以建立多項式迴歸模型了，因為這裡的點不只代表 Level 欄，也包含 Level2 欄，

cues.en: so this will build a multiple linear regression model where the independent variables are the original independent variable and the polynomial term of this first independent variable.
cues.zh: 因此會建立多元線性迴歸模型，其自變數包括原始自變數，以及該自變數的多項式項。

cues.en: And if you wanna build a polynomial regression model with a higher degree, well, you would need to do the same here.
cues.zh: 如果想建立更高次數的多項式迴歸模型，也只要在這裡做相同的事。

cues.en: You know, we can copy this line and paste it here and just add a Level3 column that will contain the cubes of the levels
cues.zh: 可以複製這一行貼在下方，新增 Level3 欄，裡面放的是

cues.en: in the original independent variable Level of our dataset.
cues.zh: 資料集原始自變數 Level 的三次方。

cues.en: And as you can see, it'll be very easy.
cues.zh: 可以看到，操作非常簡單。

cues.en: I just need to execute this line.
cues.zh: 只要執行這一行。

cues.en: And this will add a Level3 column in our dataset.
cues.zh: 就會在資料集中新增 Level3 欄。

cues.en: And so now this little dot here will be the original independent variable Level, the square values of our levels in Level2
cues.zh: 現在這個小小的點就代表原始自變數 Level、Level2 欄裡的平方值，

cues.en: and the cube values of our levels in the column Level3.
cues.zh: 以及 Level3 欄裡的三次方值。

cues.en: You can add as many powers of levels as you want, but maybe we'll stop here.
cues.zh: 你想加多少次方都可以，不過我們可能就先停在這裡。

cues.en: We will see what is the best polynomial regression for our model.
cues.zh: 接著看看哪個多項式迴歸模型最適合。

cues.en: And so we will see what we'll get with this one.
cues.zh: 先看看這個模型會得到什麼結果。

cues.en: And now let's actually build the polynomial regression model.
cues.zh: 現在實際建立多項式迴歸模型。

cues.en: If we select this and execute, press Command and Control plus Enter to execute, and done, our polynomial regression model is created.
cues.zh: 選取這段，按 Command 或 Control 加 Enter 執行，就完成了，多項式迴歸模型已建立。

cues.en: Awesome.
cues.zh: 太好了。

cues.en: So we're gonna have a look.
cues.zh: 來看一下結果。

cues.en: Let's type summary in the console poly_reg and let's press Enter and let's see what we get.
cues.zh: 在主控台輸入 summary(poly_reg)，按 Enter，看看得到什麼。

cues.en: Okay, so now what we can see is that these Level2 and Level3 polynomial terms that we created are actually statistical significant variables.
cues.zh: 現在可以看到，剛建立的 Level2 和 Level3 多項式項，都是具有統計顯著性的變數。

cues.en: But actually this table here does not show the real deal of the polynomial regression model for our problem.
cues.zh: 不過這張表還無法真正展現多項式迴歸模型對這個問題的效果。

cues.en: You will be much more convinced in the next tutorial where we'll be visualizing the graphic results, and you will perfectly understand why our polynomial regression, which is a non-linear model,
cues.zh: 下一堂課把結果畫出來，你會更有感，也會完全理解為什麼這個非線性的多項式迴歸模型，

cues.en: will make a much better job at predicting what we want compared to this linear regression model because it's a linear model.
cues.zh: 相較於線性迴歸模型，能更好地預測我們想知道的結果。

cues.en: So we'll check that in the next tutorial.
cues.zh: 下一堂課就來確認。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning!
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受機器學習的樂趣吧！
